flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/agencies/lta/download (LtaDownloadJob, LtaResponseFileParser) and sftp-common.properties (VRLS only); ocmsadminui pages/Report/lists/{ReportListLTA,ReportList}.tsx; ocmsadminapi workflows/reports/daily/DailyReportServiceImpl, notice_management/filedownload/FileDownloadController, api-authorization.properties (OCMS_REPORT_LTA). ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no renewal notice code
note: The story asks OCMS to receive a daily report from LTA about vehicles/owners with outstanding URA WAs (warrants of arrest) that were sent renewal notices, and the officer to download it. Story status is blank in stories.json (requirement not given). There is no code for a renewal notice report: no file interface, parser, entity or flag. Only the LTA VRLS infrastructure exists (SFTP /vrls/output, LtaDownloadJob cron at 05:00 and 21:00, Report > LTA tab with blob download), which serves the vehicle ownership check report generated by OCMS itself, not a report from LTA about renewal notices. It is rated Sebagian because it is a generic mechanism, not the feature the story names. LTA's delivery format/schedule and a possible route via DOS/DataHive: cannot verify from repo. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-194 (Open) concerns the LTA VRLS report, not renewal notices.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. Ask URA/LTA for the URA WA renewal notice report specification and whether it is built in another repo; today only the LTA SFTP/Report mechanism for VRLS can be reused.

steps.step: LTA sends the daily report of vehicles/owners with outstanding URA WAs that received renewal notices
steps.detail: The only LTA interface in the repo is VRLS (SFTP folders /vrls/input and /vrls/output) for vehicle ownership (ROV) enquiry. There is no file, format or spec for a URA WA renewal notice report; the word renewal does not appear in the six repos except unrelated UI i18n text. LTA's sending side: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS receives the daily report file from LTA automatically
steps.detail: LtaDownloadJob pulls files from the lta SFTP server (sftpUtil.listFiles(SFTP_SERVER, sftpDirectory) at line 308, directory sftp.folders.lta.download=/vrls/output) and cron.ltadownload runs at 05:00 and 21:00 (cron-schedules-prod.properties:148-149, enabled=true). An SFTP receive mechanism from LTA exists, but only for the VRLS Enquiry Result (691-character parser, LtaResponseFileParser.java:159), not for a renewal notice report. A file in another format would be parsed wrongly. Real server property values: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS processes the report and identifies the vehicles/owners with URA WAs that received renewal notices
steps.detail: There is no parser, entity, column or flag for renewal notices or a link to LTA warrants of arrest (WA). The only related field is roadTaxExpiryDate from the VRLS result (LtaResponseFileParser.java:243): a road tax date, not a renewal notice status, and not linked to WA. Whether this report comes via DOS/DataHive: cannot confirm from repo.

steps.step: Tagging officer opens the Report page and sees the list of LTA reports by date
steps.detail: A Report > LTA tab exists that calls daily-report/search with source LTA for a date range, shown only if the user has the REPORT_LTA function (ReportList.tsx:73). However the server only looks for files prefixed LTA_Report_ in azure.blob.lta.output (DailyReportServiceImpl.java:34, 253-254): the VRLS ownership check Excel generated by OCMS itself (LtaReportJob), not a renewal notice report from LTA. The same LTA tab is shared, so the page exists but its content is not what the story names. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-194 (Open) records that the manual LTA VRLS report still differs from URA expectations.

steps.step: Tagging officer downloads the report received from LTA
steps.detail: The Download button calls POST download/blob with source LTA mapped to azure.blob.lta.output (FileDownloadController.java:91, 114). The OCMS_REPORT_LTA authorization allows /v1/download/blob (api-authorization.properties:129-130). The download mechanism works, but only for files in the OCMS-generated VRLS report folder; a renewal notice report from LTA never lands in that folder.
